question: Where can I see and update my profile data?

sections.title: Open your profile
items: Open the toolbar features menu with the bars icon.
Click your profile entry in that menu.
Plantour opens the Profile page where your current account data is shown.

sections.title: Update your profile fields
items: Change the fields you want to update, such as Email, First Name, Last Name, or Phone.
Click Update Profile to save the changes.
Plantour keeps your current account and updates the saved profile data instead of creating a new profile.
sections.afterHtml: If you are using a temporary guest account, the email field is the important switch point for moving that account toward your real identity without losing the existing test data.

sections.title: What else you can review on the profile page
items: For admins: plan information, participant code, scheduled downgrade details, and billing actions.
For participants: the related admin name and admin email.
